name: Panama
dek: No climate table yet. The facts below are sourced; the months are blank.
paragraphs: Panama is not in the NOAA NCEI 1991–2020 collection, and no 1991–2020 monthly normal from the national met institute was found on this pass, so the climate cells are blank. ISO 4217 lists two currencies for Panama, the Balboa and the US Dollar, and both are printed.

climate.caption: No 1991–2020 month table is printed for Panama.
climate.period: a period we could not source
climate.note: Panama has no folder in the Region IV collection of the WMO 1991–2020 normals distributed by NOAA NCEI, version 6.6. A 1991–2020 monthly normal from Panama's Instituto de Meteorología e Hidrología was not found on this pass. The cells are blank rather than borrowed from another country.
climate.sourceTitle: WMO 1991-2020 Region IV directory (no Panama folder)

plugs.label: Plugs and voltage
plugs.value: Type A and B, 110 V, 60 Hz
plugs.detail: The IEC world-plugs list, in the copy archived on 16 August 2026, shows Panama at the voltage, frequency, and plug types in the figure. A direct download of the live page did not return the list, so the archive is the copy that was read.

driving.label: Driving side
driving.detail: Executive Decree 640 of 2006, the vehicle traffic regulation, article 149(b), says that on highways and expressways vehicles travel in the right lane, with stated exceptions, and article 155(i) allows passing on the right only exceptionally. The copy read is hosted by the Judicial Branch; later amendments were not checked.

tipping.label: Tipping
tipping.value: Voluntary; cannot be charged unless agreed
tipping.detail: Panama's government procedures portal, on the consumer agency ACODECO's tip complaint, says a tip is voluntary and cannot be added as a charge unless the service was contracted in advance; it may be suggested if the invoice shows the total. It gives no percentage.

water.label: Tap water
water.detail: CDC's traveler page for Panama, last reviewed November 10, 2026, does not say whether tap water is safe or unsafe. It says food and water standards around the world vary based on the destination, that standards may also differ within a country, and that risk may change depending on the activity. It points readers to CDC's food and water precautions. This page does not turn that into medical advice.

currency.label: Currency
currency.detail: ISO 4217 lists two currencies for Panama: Balboa, code PAB, and US Dollar, code USD. Both are printed.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.detail: IANA's zone.tab and zone1970.tab each give Panama one row, America/Panama. There is no second zone for the country in either file.
